title: The RSV beatitudes call the poor in spirit blessed
summary: The RSV of Matthew 5 blesses the poor in spirit.
body: The Revised Standard Version of Matthew 5 begins the beatitudes with a blessing on the poor in spirit. The lines are presented as Jesus' teaching on a mountain. A different Gospel and a different translation will not use the same English. The wording on the page includes: "down his disciples came to him. 2 And he opened his mouth and taught them, saying: 3 “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. 4 “Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted. 5 “Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth. 6 “Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
